The result downloads as a standalone HTML file you can open, explore, and share.
It outputs standalone HTML files you can download, open, or share immediately.
It is MIT licensed, created for Claude Code and Codex.
Run npx skills add tt-a1i/archify -g, then describe your idea.
Send this to someone who needs to see system flow clearly.
Make any plan, or codebase beautiful instantly.
